lines.text: Milo the little bear loved eating delicious berry pies and sweet honeycomb!
Whenever friends brought him gifts, Milo snatched them up without saying a word!
Soon, his friends felt unappreciated and stopped visiting his cozy treehouse!
Milo felt sad and asked his mama, Why is nobody coming over to play?
Mama smiled gently and said, People love sharing when their kindness is recognized!
Milo baked fresh warm cookies and ran across the forest to say Thank You!
Thank you for the berries! Thank you for the honey! Thank you for being my friends!
Saying Thank You spreads warm sunshine into everyone around you!
Practice gratitude every day and subscribe to BabyBeats Rhymo!
